name: Auto-Checkpoint Interval Manager
description: Automatically places practice mode checkpoints at player-defined percentage or time intervals.

enabled.name: Enable Auto-Checkpoint
enabled.description: Toggle automatic checkpoint placement on or off.

interval-type.name: Interval Mode
interval-type.description: Choose whether checkpoints trigger based on Level Percentage or Time Elapsed.

use-time.name: Use Time-based Intervals
use-time.description: If enabled, checkpoints trigger based on seconds instead of percentage progress.

percentage-interval.name: Percentage Interval (%)
percentage-interval.description: Place a checkpoint every X% progress.

time-interval.name: Time Interval (Seconds)
time-interval.description: Place a checkpoint every X seconds.
